messages.content: Help me generate the XContent with xContentBuilderInstance for a RootObjectMapper that includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection, while skipping runtime fields?

function.name: RootObjectMapper_doXContent
function.description: Serializes the RootObjectMapper settings to XContent, with options to include default values and to skip runtime fields. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

builder.description: The XContentBuilder to which the content should be written. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

params.description: Parameters controlling the serialization, including whether to include defaults and whether to skip runtime fields. This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type any; they are not in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function RootObjectMapper_doXContent with builder and params. We need to provide builder as string representation of XContentBuilder instance. And params as string representation of ArrayList containing options: include defaults, skip runtime fields. Also we need to set dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection. But the function only serializes settings; we need to set those on the RootObjectMapper before calling. But we don't have actual code context. We just need to produce the XContent output. So we need to construct a RootObjectMapper with those settings, then call doXContent with includeDefaults=true, skipRuntimeFields=true. Then return the XContent.

Thus we need to call functions.RootObjectMapper_doXContent with builder and params. Provide builder as "xContentBuilderInstance" (string). Params as arraylist with two booleans: true, true. Then the function returns XContent. We'll output that.
